sources.title: Stream salinity status and trends in south-west Western Australia
sources.date_basis: Title page, Report No. SLUI 38, January 2005.
sources.hash_scope: Complete original PDF response bytes, rechecked locally; not a text capture or map crop.
sources.source_role: Official regional course descriptions, component distinctions and complete Southwest study-area river map.
own_factual_extraction: Collie passes Wellington Reservoir and reaches Leschenault Inlet. Distinct tributaries include Collie River East, Collie River South Branch, Harris, Bingham and Brunswick.
The Warren description identifies Tone as the upstream river and separately names Perup, Wilgarup and Lefroy tributaries. Figure 3.27 distinguishes their regional drainage corridors.
limits: The regional map does not provide a coordinate-resolved name boundary for each selected baseline part. Distinct official publications may share geographic source data.
